summary: Rocket One Inc., a Nasdaq-listed AI, space and defense technology company formerly known as Hoth Therapeutics, filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing a definitive membership interest purchase agreement to acquire 100% of Tracer Drone Technologies, LLC, a New Jersey-based drone hardware, software, training, maintenance and managed services provider. No purchase price, consideration mix or premium was disclosed. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions, with Tracer expected to operate as a wholly owned subsidiary. No board recommendation, advisor or financing terms were named. Deal terms remain opaque; watch for subsequent disclosures on price, funding and closing timing.
